# Tubox

> Privacy-first image toolbox with 13 browser-based tools. Selected images are processed on the user's device and are not uploaded.

## Canonical pages

- Home: https://tubox.top/
- English home: https://tubox.top/en
- Batch image processing: https://tubox.top/batch
- AI background removal: https://tubox.top/cutout
- AI image upscaling: https://tubox.top/upscale
- ID and passport photos: https://tubox.top/id-photo
- EXIF metadata viewer and remover: https://tubox.top/exif
- Image annotation and pixelation: https://tubox.top/annotate
- Long image stitcher: https://tubox.top/collage/long
- Collage maker: https://tubox.top/collage/grid
- Grid splitter: https://tubox.top/collage/nine
- Social layouts: https://tubox.top/collage/social
- GIF maker: https://tubox.top/gif
- Video to GIF: https://tubox.top/video-to-gif
- QR code generator: https://tubox.top/qr-code

## Product facts

- No account is required for core tools.
- Selected images are decoded, processed and exported in the browser.
- AI inference uses WebGPU when available and falls back to WebAssembly.
- AI model files load on demand and may require a network download.
- EXIF, XMP, IPTC and PNG text metadata can be removed without recompressing image pixels.
- The interface supports ten languages.
- Source code: https://github.com/jackple/tubox
- License: AGPL-3.0-only

## Privacy clarification

"Local processing" means selected images stay in the browser. It does not mean the website works offline: the application, fonts and AI model files still load from the network.
